_tuning_notes: River hippo, the territory tank. territory.radius = aggro zone in blocks around the water-anchored claim (anchor 'water' snaps the center to the nearest water within 8 at spawn; 'spawn' uses the spawn spot); aggro_inside=false would make it decorative. Intruders (survival players, boats) get a 3s yawn warning, then a charge; calms ~20s after the zone empties. knockback feeds ATTACK_KNOCKBACK. Boats die in 2 bites and drop planks+sticks (hardcoded drama). Babies are leashed to half the radius. Phase 3: breed_item melon (also the cage bait); cage_tier 2. RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (2-4, cap 6). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever.
guide_blurb: Kills more boats than any reef.
